package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/outbox"
)

type publishResult struct {
	EventID  uuid.UUID `json:"event_id"`
	Stream   string    `json:"stream"`
	Sequence int64     `json:"sequence"`
}

type recordingBroker struct {
	delegate outbox.Broker
	result   publishResult
}

func (broker *recordingBroker) Publish(
	ctx context.Context,
	subject string,
	messageID string,
	payload []byte,
) (outbox.Receipt, error) {
	receipt, err := broker.delegate.Publish(ctx, subject, messageID, payload)
	if err != nil {
		return outbox.Receipt{}, err
	}
	broker.result = publishResult{
		EventID:  uuid.MustParse(messageID),
		Stream:   receipt.Stream,
		Sequence: receipt.Sequence,
	}
	return receipt, nil
}

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	connection, err := nats.Connect(
		os.Getenv("VELA_NATS_URL"),
		nats.Timeout(5*time.Second),
	)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer connection.Close()
	jetStream, err := outbox.NewJetStreamBroker(connection)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	broker := &recordingBroker{delegate: jetStream}
	publisher, err := outbox.NewPublisher(pool, broker, outbox.Config{
		InstanceID: "slice-29-n-minus-one-outbox",
		BatchSize:  1,
		ClaimTTL:   30 * time.Second,
		RetryDelay: 0,
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	published, err := publisher.PublishBatch(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if published != 1 || broker.result.EventID == uuid.Nil {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("published %d retained events, want one", published))
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(broker.result); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
